name: Custom Shape Wooden Tabletop Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality natural wood, offering a warm, sturdy, and decorative display finish.
    - Features a layered wooden construction that creates a dimensional 3D look with a premium handcrafted feel.
    - Each wooden layer has a thickness of 4mm, providing durability and a solid structure for a tabletop display.
    - Comes with a black stake and rectangular base for stable standing support.
    - Includes an additional charm with 2-sided printing and a hanging rope for extra decorative detail.
    - Smooth cut edges and vivid printed surfaces enhance the overall appearance with a clean and polished finish.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Main wooden sign size: 4 x 4 in ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm.
    - Stake length: 12 cm ~ 4.7 in
    - Stake diameter: 0.7 cm ~ 0.28 in
    - Base size: 7 x 5 cm ~ 2.76 x 1.97 in
    - Base height: 1.5 cm ~ 0.59 in
    - Wooden charm size: 2 x 2 in ~ 5.08 x 5.08 cm

📌 Note: The dimensions of the wooden sign and wooden charm may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed. The stake and base size are fixed and cannot be changed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - Single-sided printing is applied to the layers 1, 2, 3 and 4.
    - Double-sided printing is applied to the wooden charm.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized tabletop sign and a decorative keepsake.
    - Designed to stand securely on desks, shelves, countertops, office tables, or display corners.
    - Layered structure creates a more lively and dimensional visual effect.
    - Suitable for home décor, office décor, celebration displays, and themed gift setups.
    - Perfect for showcasing names, milestones, hobbies, patriotic themes, sports themes, or meaningful messages.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, Father’s Day, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for sports lovers, hobby enthusiasts, patriotic gifts, and custom keepsakes.
    - A thoughtful gift for home decoration, desk display, and memorable occasion collections.
    - Great for themed rooms, office desks, souvenir displays, and personalized gift giving.
    - Adds a warm, creative, and memorable touch to any space🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom Shape Wooden Tabletop Sign

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
